arguments.value: Joseph III Dawson was born in 1970 in Fort Jackson, South Carolina, and has served as a United States District Judge for the District of South Carolina since his confirmation in December 2020. He earned a B.A. from The Citadel in 1991 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina School of Law in 1997. Prior to joining the bench, he spent more than two decades with Charleston County, South Carolina, serving as assistant county attorney, deputy county attorney, and county attorney, while also maintaining a part-time private practice in North Charleston. Dawson also served in the South Carolina Army National Guard and the U.S. Army Reserve as a captain in the Judge Advocate General’s Corps, and he was a member of the South Carolina Judicial Department’s Board of Law Examiners from 2019 to 2020.
